evidence: Cic. Inv. 1.109: quemadmodum enim dīxit rhētor Apollōnius, lacrimā nihil citius ārēscit
terms.comment: Cicero quotes it from the rhetorician Apollonius, as advice not to dwell on an appeal to pity. Lacrimā is ablative of comparison: “nothing dries more quickly than a tear”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Cicero, De inventione 1.109, checked against the Perseus Latin texts (12 November 2026).
